question: How can I test my SDK code locally before publishing it?
ground_truth: You can use the `--preview` flag with the fern generate command to test your SDK code locally. This generates SDK code into a local `.preview/` folder within your `fern` folder without publishing any changes to package managers or GitHub. You can preview all SDKs with `fern generate --preview` or a specific language SDK with `fern generate --group <language>-sdk --preview`.
